process of gastric digestion, most of the food becomes semi-
liquid chyme, which is 50% water. When food is consumed, 
significant numbers of microorganisms are also consumed. The 
stomach pH is low, ranging from about 1 to 4. The combined 
actions of hydrochloric acid and proteolytic enzymes result in a 
significant reduction in the concentration of viable microor-
ganisms. Some microbes may escape and enter the intestine if
